retrievalProfile.description: A high-intensity macro portrait focusing on the eyes and a patterned face covering with a gritty, film-like grain.

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a person's face from the bridge of the nose upward, featuring piercing blue eyes and a black-and-white paisley bandana covering the lower half, characterized by a warm skin tone and heavy film grain.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two eyes across the vertical axis
Contrast between organic skin texture and geometric bandana patterns
Color pop of blue irises against warm beige skin and monochrome fabric
Horizontal division of the frame between skin and textile
coreInvariants: Visible film grain or digital noise texture
Extreme macro crop focusing on the eye line
High-contrast black and white paisley pattern

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The eyes are positioned in the upper third of the frame, scaled to dominate the visual field.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pupils of the blue eyes serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's gaze starts at the eyes and moves downward to the intricate details of the bandana pattern.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the frame is tightly packed with the subject's features.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the bandana; muted saturation in the skin with a specific color pop in the eyes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a macro photograph of a person's eyes with a black and white paisley bandana covering the nose and mouth. Use warm lighting and apply a heavy film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a distressed sans-serif font placed in the lower third over the bandana pattern using a high-contrast white fill.

verificationChecks: Are the eyes the sharpest point of focus?
Is the grain texture consistent across the skin and fabric?
Is the bandana pattern clearly black and white?

mustRedesign: Do not use flat, digital-looking black areas
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical symmetry in the eyes
Verify the paisley pattern does not look AI-warped
Ensure the crop is tight enough to exclude hair and chin
Confirm the blue of the eyes is the only significant non-neutral color
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro portrait + [Eye Color] eyes + [Pattern Type] face covering + heavy film grain + warm skin tones.
